intent.summary: Flagship portable air-quality detector housing with premium soft-touch painted finish, IP67 waterproof, ultra-slim 18 mm profile, 100% recycled plastic, under 120 g total mass, and housing cost ≤ CNY 9, launching in six weeks.

conflicts.description: IP67 waterproofing typically requires sealing features, gaskets, and thicker walls, making an 18 mm ultra-slim profile extremely challenging, especially with recycled ABS which may have lower flow and strength.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Relax thickness to at least 22-25 mm or reduce waterproof rating to IP54; alternatively use overmolded gaskets and ultrasonic welding but still likely exceeds 18 mm.

conflicts.description: Achieving total mass under 120 g with internals weighing ~92 g leaves only 28 g for the housing. An IP67 enclosure with soft-touch paint and recycled ABS is unlikely to be that light.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Increase mass budget to at least 150 g or reduce internal weight; use thinner walls only if waterproofing is relaxed.

conflicts.description: Housing cost ≤ CNY 9 with 100% recycled ABS, soft-touch painting, and IP67 sealing is likely infeasible at 10k units/year; painting and sealing add significant cost.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Increase cost ceiling to at least CNY 15-18 or drop painting/IP67; consider molded-in texture instead of paint.

conflicts.description: Launch in six weeks is very aggressive for tooling, testing (especially IP67), and painting process validation with recycled material.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Extend timeline to at least 12-16 weeks or simplify requirements (e.g., IP54, no paint).
